name: Teen Volunteering and Summer Teen Internship (Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula
city: Menlo Park, CA (Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula, 401 Pierce Rd., serving San Mateo County)
what_you_do: You help younger kids with homework once a week during the school year. In summer, teen interns help with classes and fun learning time at the club's summer program.
grades: Summer Teen Internship: rising 9th to 12th grade
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and up. Summer Teen Internship: rising high school freshmen through seniors who are 14 or older. To intern or volunteer you must have a Social Security Number and be able to complete a background check.
pay_detail: School-year Program Support is unpaid volunteering. Pay for the Summer Teen Internship is not stated; it is listed on the club's Volunteer page.
duration: Program Support: at least 1 hour a week on the same day for at least 6 weeks, Monday to Thursday, 3:00 to 6:00 PM, September to May. Summer internship: at least 3 weeks in June to July, Monday to Friday, mornings, afternoons or both.
deadline_text: Program Support: rolling applications during the school year (September to May). Summer Teen Internship: application opens March 2027 (exact day not posted).
how_to_apply: Use the Sign Up and Apply Here links on the club's Volunteer page. Questions? Email Emily Mungul at emungul@bgcp.org.
notes: The page links a separate document on the application process and compliance rules. The SSN requirement is for the club's background check; a teen without an SSN cannot do this one. Summer internship hours are 8:00 am to 12:00 pm, 1:00 to 5:00 pm, or both. BGCP's paid Youth Program Leader jobs ($22 to $25 an hour) do not list an age. Mid-Peninsula Boys & Girls Club and Boys & Girls Clubs of North San Mateo County have joined BGCP, per BGCP's news page.
